job.title: Executive Assistant
job.description:
Ecolab is hiring an Executive Assistant to support two vice presidents in our Saint Paul headquarters.

Responsibilities:
- Manage complex calendars across time zones
- Arrange domestic and international travel and process expense reports in Concur
- Prepare meeting materials and PowerPoint presentations
- Coordinate team meetings, offsites and events
- Handle confidential information with discretion
- Act as the first point of contact for internal and external partners

Qualifications:
- 5+ years of administrative experience, executive support preferred
- Advanced Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint
- Experience with Concur or similar expense tools
- Excellent organization and communication
- Ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment

professionalSummary.summary: Administrative assistant with 9 years supporting a busy clinic office: calendars, billing questions and keeping the office running.

achievements: Managed calendars for 4 dentists with 120+ appointments a week
Answered billing and insurance questions for patients
Ordered office and clinical supplies within a $3,000 monthly budget
Planned the annual staff retreat for 25 people
Moved patient reminders from phone calls to text messages, cutting no-shows by 18%
Checked in 80+ patients a day at a primary care front desk
